question: Why does the review recommend dissolving the aluminium foil in an alkaline solution to separate the cathode materials?
expect: False premise: it says dissolving Al in an alkaline solution is not a sustainable separation method, since recovering the Cu and Al current collectors matters (p7.L84-88)
rendered: The review does not recommend dissolving the aluminium foil in an alkaline solution to separate the cathode materials. In fact, it mentions that dissolving Al in an alkaline solution is not a sustainable separation method because Cu smelting processes are the key contributors to emissions of SOx and other greenhouse gases in the cradle-to-gate stages of the battery life cycle.
